svg.title: DIR Warm Proof brand identity board
svg.desc: A three by three production identity board for DIR — Do It Right, showing the existing right-path deer mark, brand meaning, construction, light and dark palettes, typography, Next Mark, proof-line task rows, and focus application.

g.text: CAPTURE → CLARIFY → CHOOSE → FOCUS → COMPLETE → REVIEW
Direction without control, pressure, or performance.
The existing geometry carries choice and completion.
A messy list narrows to one useful move.
HUMAN CONTROL • PRIVATE BY DEFAULT • SHAME-FREE
Keep type and edges outside x.
No redraws, rotations, or new variants.
Warm paper, crisp ink, and restrained terracotta.
Charcoal field, warm white ink, brighter action mark.
One mark is enough. You can choose again after this.
One factual line system; no card-within-card decoration.
Buy refill filters for the kitchen tap
Draft the first section, not the whole report.
